qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted franchise territories and rate-base regulation for gas distribution and electric utilities across Indiana and Mid-Atlantic states.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet). NiSource holds fully regulated gas and electric distribution franchises across 6 states. However, it operates with severe debt leverage (LT debt/NI of 16.6x) and weak interest coverage of 2.87x (below 5.0x requirement). Its heavy capital modernization program ($2.8B capex vs $930M net income) requires perpetual debt financing and asset stake sales, relying on the kindness of strangers.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year GAAP ROIC median of 6.35% (2025: 6.63%, 2024: 6.40%, 2020: 3.05%, 2018: 0.80%). LT debt of $15.46B against net income of $929.5M represents 16.6x debt-to-earnings leverage (exceeds 4.0x ceiling). FY2025 EBIT of $1.84B covers $639M interest at 2.87x (below 5.0x threshold). Negative owner cash flow after capex requires perpetual debt issuances and minority equity sales.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
